decision_condition.FAIL: Candidate is more complex and at least one incremental-value criterion is FAIL.
decision_condition.MIXED: Complexity vectors are incomparable, or the candidate is more complex with no incremental-value FAIL/UNRESOLVED and at least one incremental-value MIXED.
decision_condition.PASS: Candidate is no more complex than every reference, or it is more complex and discrimination, calibration, and practical_utility are all PASS.

criteria.metric_statistic: Pareto partial order over non-negative observable component counts; no weighted complexity score.
criteria.rationale: Counts are reproducibly derivable from the predictor graph and Pareto ordering avoids subjective weights. Sprint 37 established joint relevance, rejected a single best metric, and permitted the simplest defensible candidate, but did not freeze this exact conjunction. Sprint 41 prospectively and conservatively requires simultaneous PASS in discrimination, calibration, and practical_utility so isolated favorable performance cannot justify extra complexity. stability_across_origins remains separately mandatory under Sprint 39 because robustness across time is scientifically distinct from incremental value.

required_evidence.future_state_timing: The incremental-value states do not exist merely because Sprint 41 defines their rules; they may be derived only in a later explicitly authorized evaluation using this operationalization.
required_evidence.prospective_policy_status: Requiring simultaneous PASS in discrimination, calibration, and practical_utility for a strictly more-complex candidate is a new prospective, conservative, outcome-independent Sprint 41 operationalization; it is not an exact rule historically frozen by Sprint 37.
required_evidence.stability_separation: stability_across_origins remains an independent required Sprint 39 scientific criterion. It asks whether behavior is directionally stable across frozen temporal origins, whereas complexity_parsimony asks whether multidimensional incremental scientific value justifies extra complexity. Exclusion from this conjunction does not make stability optional and introduces no combined weight or score.

criteria.scientific_intent: Prevent preference for additional modalities/components unless the extra burden is accompanied by defensible incremental scientific value.
